conceptZh: 豬探長用大放大鏡找蜜蜂，蜂字的筆畫從邊邊探頭又躲開，最後被他一口氣「抓到」。
object: a detective pig with an oversized magnifying glass
morph: strokes of 蜂 sneak in from edges and dodge the pig's lens until they settle
creativeAngle: 捉迷藏：放大鏡把筆畫放大，筆畫一躲就縮小。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale butter-cream background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 蜂 as the only text on screen, drawn in honey amber solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a stout pig detective in a checked deerstalker waddles in holding a magnifying glass bigger than himself and stares through it; the first 蜂 is spoken as the left 虫 pops its head in from the left edge, then ducks. 1.7-3.4s: through the lens the pig spots the right-hand 夆 pieces peeking from the top and bottom edges; he spins, they dodge like pixie dust, and the second 蜂 is spoken as the lens magnifies one piece so large that it falls on his snout and clicks into place. 3.4-5s: 蜜蜂 is spoken as a fuzzy toy bee hums out of a honey-pot beside him, circles the lens, and the pig's eye in the glass goes huge. 5-8s: hold; the bee lands on the pig's hat and the pig wiggles his curly tail, glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "蜂、蜂、蜜蜂" (ㄈㄥ、ㄈㄥ、ㄇㄧˋ ㄈㄥ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 蜂 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
